description: Production Adsterra frames use www.freecause.com, with the existing same-origin sandbox that omits allow-same-origin. The network still decides whether to return an advertisement.
application: Apply this runtime setting only after deploying the dedicatedFrameHostMatchesRequest guards. Settings override config/ads.php and ADS_FRAME_ORIGIN. This reference is not executed automatically by deployment.
legacy_host: ads.freecause.com redirects to the corresponding canonical URL when it is no longer the configured frame host.
rollback: Restore ads_frame_origin to https://ads.freecause.com before rolling back to code without the shared-host guards.
